title: Kodewala Academy – Java Backend Class Test 1

questions.question: Which of the following is a valid variable name?
questions.explanation: Variable names cannot start with numbers, contain hyphens, or use reserved keywords.

questions.question: Which command compiles a Java program?
questions.explanation: javac converts source code into bytecode.

questions.question: Which symbol is used to terminate a statement in Java?
questions.explanation: Most Java statements end with a semicolon.

questions.question: Which component executes Java bytecode?
questions.explanation: JVM loads and executes .class files.

questions.question: Which variable belongs to an object?
questions.explanation: Every object gets its own copy of instance variables.

questions.question: Which variable is shared among all objects?
questions.explanation: Static variables belong to the class, not objects.

questions.question:
What is the output?

```java
System.out.println(10 + 20 + "Java");
```
questions.explanation: Integer addition happens before string concatenation.

questions.question: Which statement is correct?
questions.explanation: JRE = JVM + runtime libraries.

questions.question:
What is the output?

```java
System.out.println(10 + "20" + 30);
```
questions.explanation: Once a String appears, concatenation starts.
b + c becomes int, not byte.
Array contains two elements.

questions.question: Is the main() method mandatory in every Java class?

options.A: Yes, every class must have it
options.B: No, only the class that needs to be executed directly requires it

questions.correct_answer: B. No, only the class that needs to be executed directly requires it
questions.explanation: A Java class can exist without a main() method. However, to run directly via JVM, main() is required.

questions.question: Which is the correct signature of the main() method?
questions.correct_answer: C. public static void main(String[] args)
questions.explanation: The JVM looks for exactly public static void main(String[] args).

questions.question: Which of the following is a valid Java class name?
questions.explanation: Class names follow identifier rules and PascalCase convention.

questions.question: What happens if a class does not contain a main() method and you try to run it?

options.B: Runtime Error: Main method not found

questions.correct_answer: B. Runtime Error: Main method not found
questions.explanation: The class compiles, but JVM throws Main method not found error on execution.

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of JIT (Just-In-Time) Compiler?

options.A: To convert source code to bytecode
options.D: To convert bytecode into machine code during execution for better performance

questions.correct_answer: D. To convert bytecode into machine code during execution for better performance
questions.explanation: JIT converts frequently executed bytecode into native machine code.

questions.question: Why should hardcoding values be avoided in Java applications?

options.C: It makes maintenance and configuration difficult

questions.correct_answer: C. It makes maintenance and configuration difficult
questions.explanation: Hardcoded values make maintenance hard; external configuration is preferred.

questions.question: Why is Java called a Platform Independent language?

options.A: Java works only on Windows and Linux
options.C: Java bytecode can run on any platform that has a JVM

questions.correct_answer: C. Java bytecode can run on any platform that has a JVM
questions.explanation: WORA: Write Once, Run Anywhere via JVM.

questions.question: Where are objects stored in Java memory?
questions.explanation: Objects created with new are stored in Heap Memory.

questions.question: Where are local variables stored?
questions.explanation: Local variables declared inside methods are stored in Stack Memory.

questions.question: What is a common use case of a static variable in Java?

options.B: Storing data shared by all objects of a class

questions.correct_answer: B. Storing data shared by all objects of a class
questions.explanation: Static variables belong to the class and are shared by all objects.

questions.question: What is the scope of a local variable in Java?

options.C: Only within the method/block where it is declared

questions.correct_answer: C. Only within the method/block where it is declared
questions.explanation: Local variables are accessible only within their declaring method or block.

questions.question: Which statement about the main() method is TRUE?

options.A: Every class must contain a main method.
options.C: A class can compile without a main method.

questions.correct_answer: C. A class can compile without a main method.
questions.explanation: A class without main compiles successfully.

questions.question: What is the relationship between a .java file, classes, and .class files?
questions.explanation: One .class file is generated for each class defined in the source file.

questions.question: Which statement is TRUE?

options.A: A .class file contains Java source code.
options.B: One .java file can contain multiple classes.
options.C: A Java file cannot have helper classes.

questions.correct_answer: B. One .java file can contain multiple classes.
questions.explanation: A file can contain multiple classes (at most one public class).

questions.question: File Name is Demo.java. What happens if public class Test is inside it?
questions.explanation: Public class name must match the file name.

questions.question: What happens when the program is executed without arguments and accesses args[0]?
questions.explanation: Accessing empty args array at index 0 throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.
Safely checks args.length before accessing.

questions.question: What is the output when executed as 'java Test Java Spring Boot'?
questions.explanation: Three arguments are passed, so args.length is 3.

questions.question: A Java Employee class handles salary calculation, PDF generation, and emailing. Which SOLID principle is violated?
questions.explanation: Mixing multiple responsibilities violates SRP.

questions.question: What does the “S” in SOLID stand for?
questions.explanation: S stands for Single Responsibility Principle.

questions.question: A developer hardcodes a payment URL inside a Java class. What is the main disadvantage?

options.C: Changes require modifying and redeploying the source code

questions.correct_answer: C. Changes require modifying and redeploying the source code
questions.explanation: Hardcoded values require code recompilation and redeployment upon change.

questions.question: When a static method is called, where is method call information stored during execution?
questions.explanation: Method call frames are stored on the Stack.
true && false evaluates to false.
Short-circuit OR (||) skips second operand when first is true.

questions.question: Gathering business requirements and client expectations before writing code belongs to which SDLC phase?
questions.explanation: Requirement analysis focuses on gathering client requirements.

questions.question: What is a JAR file in Java?

options.B: Java Archive file used to package Java classes and resources

questions.correct_answer: B. Java Archive file used to package Java classes and resources
questions.explanation: JAR bundles compiled classes and resources.

questions.question: Which command is used to create a JAR file?
questions.explanation: jar cvf creates a new archive file.
